mapper.select:
select `bco`.`coupon_name`, case when `bco`.`coupon_type` = 0 then '代金券' when `bco`.`coupon_type` = 1 then '折扣券' when `bco`.`coupon_type` = 2 then '兑换券' when `bco`.`coupon_type` = 3 then '套餐券' when `bco`.`coupon_type` = 4 then '充值卡' else null end as coupon_type, `bcd`.`card_number`, `bp`.`name` as `cardOwner`, `bcd`.`sale_channel_name`, `bo`.`abbreviation` as `usedClinicName`, date_format(`bf`.`use_date`, '%Y-%m-%d') as `usedDate`, `bp1`.`name` as `usedPatientName`, `bp1`.`mobile` as `usedPatientMobile`, `be`.`employee_name` as `dentistName`, `bb`.`bill_num` as `billNumber`, `bb`.`order_amount`, ifnull(sum(`bf`.`benefit_amount`), 0)as `benefitAmount`, `bb`.`actual_amount`, `be1`.`employee_name` as `operateBenefitUser` from `base_benefit` `bf` inner join `base_coupon` `bco` on `bco`.`coupon_id` = `bf`.`coupon_id` inner join `base_card` `bcd` on `bcd`.`card_id` = `bf`.`card_id` inner join `base_bill` `bb` on `bb`.`bill_id` = `bf`.`order_id`
inner join `base_patient` `bp` on `bp`.`patient_id` = `bcd`.`patient_id`
inner join `base_patient` `bp1` on `bp1`.`patient_id` = `bf`.`patient_id` inner join `base_treatment_process` `btp` on `btp`.`treatment_id` = `bb`.`treatment_id`
inner join `base_employee` `be` on `be`.`user_id` = `btp`.`registered_dentist_id` inner join `base_organization` `bo` on `bo`.`org_id` = `bf`.`org_id`
inner join `base_employee` `be1` on `be1`.`user_id` = `bf`.`operate_user_id` where `bco`.`coupon_type` != 4
and `bco`.`coupon_name` like concat('%', #{couponName}, '%')
and `bb`.`bill_num` like concat('%', #{billNumber}, '%')
and `bcd`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{cardNumber}, '%')
and (`bp1`.`name` like concat('%', #{patientKeyWord}, '%') or `bp1`.`mobile` like concat('%', #{patientKeyWord}, '%') or `bp1`.`pinyin_name` like concat('%', #{patientKeyWord}, '%'))
and `bf`.`org_id` in
#{item}
and `btp`.`registered_dentist_id` in
#{item}
and (`bf`.`use_date` >= #{usedStartDate} and `bf`.`use_date` < DATE_ADD(#{usedEndDate} ,INTERVAL '1' DAY))
and `bcd`.`sale_channel_id` in
#{item}
and `bco`.`coupon_type` in
#{item}
group by `bf`.`card_id`, `bf`.`order_id` order by `bf`.`use_date` desc

select `bcd`.`card_number`, `bp`.`name` as `cardOwner`, `bcd`.`sale_channel_name`, `bo`.`abbreviation` as `usedClinicName`, date_format(`bf`.`use_date`, '%Y-%m-%d') as `usedDate`, `bp1`.`name` as `usedPatientName`, `bp1`.`mobile` as `usedPatientMobile`, `be`.`employee_name` as `dentistName`, `bb`.`bill_num` as `billNumber`, `bb`.`order_amount`, ifnull(sum(`bf`.`benefit_amount`), 0)as `benefitAmount`, `bb`.`actual_amount`, `be1`.`employee_name` as `operateBenefitUser` from `base_benefit` `bf` left join `base_card` `bcd` on `bcd`.`card_id` = `bf`.`card_id` left join `base_bill` `bb` on `bb`.`bill_id` = `bf`.`order_id`
left join `base_patient` `bp` on `bp`.`patient_id` = `bcd`.`patient_id`
left join `base_patient` `bp1` on `bp1`.`patient_id` = `bf`.`patient_id` left join `base_treatment_process` `btp` on `btp`.`treatment_id` = `bb`.`treatment_id`
left join `base_employee` `be` on `be`.`user_id` = `btp`.`registered_dentist_id` left join `base_organization` `bo` on `bo`.`org_id` = `bf`.`org_id`
left join `base_employee` `be1` on `be1`.`user_id` = `bf`.`operate_user_id` where `bf`.`coupon_id` = #{couponId}
and `bcd`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{cardNumber}, '%')
and (`bp1`.`name` like concat('%', #{patientKeyWord}, '%') or `bp1`.`mobile` like concat('%', #{patientKeyWord}, '%') or `bp1`.`pinyin_name` like concat('%', #{patientKeyWord}, '%'))
and `bb`.`bill_num` like concat('%', #{billNumber}, '%')
and `bf`.`org_id` in
#{item}
and `btp`.`registered_dentist_id` in
#{item}
and (`bf`.`use_date` >= #{usedStartDate} and `bf`.`use_date` < #{usedEndDate})
and `bcd`.`sale_channel_id` in
#{item}
group by `bf`.`card_id`, `bf`.`order_id` order by `bf`.`use_date` desc

select bcd.card_id as cardId, bb.bill_id as order_id, date_format(`bf`.`use_date`, '%Y-%m-%d') as `usedDate`, date_format(`bb`.`order_date`, '%Y-%m-%d') as `orderDate`, `bb`.`bill_num` as `billNumber`, `bp`.`name` as `usedPatientName`, `bp`.`mobile` as `usedPatientMobile`, `bco`.`coupon_name`, case when `bco`.`coupon_type` = 0 then '代金券' when `bco`.`coupon_type` = 1 then '折扣券' when `bco`.`coupon_type` = 2 then '兑换券' when `bco`.`coupon_type` = 3 then '套餐券' when `bco`.`coupon_type` = 4 then '充值卡' else null end as coupon_type, `bcd`.`sale_channel_name`, `bcd`.`card_number`, `be`.`employee_name` as `operateBenefitUser` from `base_benefit` `bf` inner join `base_coupon` `bco` on `bco`.`coupon_id` = `bf`.`coupon_id` inner join `base_card` `bcd` on `bcd`.`card_id` = `bf`.`card_id` left join `base_bill` `bb` on `bb`.`bill_id` = `bf`.`order_id`
left join `base_patient` `bp` on `bp`.`patient_id` = `bf`.`patient_id`
left join `base_employee` `be` on `be`.`user_id` = `bf`.`operate_user_id` where `bco`.`coupon_type` != 4
and `bf`.`org_id` = #{orgId}
and (`bf`.`use_date` >= #{usedStartDate} and `bf`.`use_date` < date_add(#{usedEndDate}, interval 1 day))
and `bco`.`coupon_name` like concat('%', #{couponName}, '%')
and `bcd`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{cardNumber}, '%')
and (`bp`.`name` like concat('%', #{patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp`.`mobile` like concat('%', #{patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp`.`pinyin_name` like concat('%', #{patientKeyword}, '%'))
and `bco`.`coupon_type` in
#{item}
and `bcd`.`sale_channel_id` in
#{item}
group by `bf`.`card_id`, `bf`.`order_id` order by `bf`.`use_date` desc

select sum(bf.benefit_amount) as amount, count(bf.coupon_id) as num, bt.item_num as itemNum, bt.item_name as itemName, be.employee_name as executor from base_benefit bf inner join base_coupon bco on bco.coupon_id = bf.coupon_id left join base_tariff_info bt on bt.item_id=bf.item_id and bt.item_type=bf.item_type left join base_employee be on be.user_id = bf.operate_user_id where bco.coupon_type != 4 and bf.order_id = #{query.orderId} and bf.card_id = #{query.cardId} group by bf.coupon_id,bf.order_detail_id,bt.item_num,bt.item_name,bf.operate_user_id order by `bf`.`use_date` desc

SELECT `bti`.`item_id`, `bti`.`item_name`, `bti`.`item_type`, count(*) AS useQuantity, date_format( `bf`.`use_date`, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS `useDate`, `bo`.`abbreviation` AS `usedClinicName`, `bp`.`name` AS `usedPatientName`, `be`.`employee_name` AS `dentistName`, ifnull( sum( `bf`.`benefit_amount` ), 0 ) AS `benefitAmount` FROM `base_benefit` `bf` LEFT JOIN `base_bill` `bb` ON `bb`.`bill_id` = `bf`.`order_id` LEFT JOIN `base_treatment_process` `btp` ON `btp`.`treatment_id` = `bb`.`treatment_id` AND `btp`.`patient_id` = `bf`.`patient_id` -- 挂号医生 LEFT JOIN `base_employee` `be` ON `be`.`user_id` = `btp`.`registered_dentist_id` LEFT JOIN `base_tariff_info` `bti` ON `bti`.`item_id` = `bf`.`item_id` AND `bti`.`item_type` = `bf`.`item_type` -- 优惠券使用患者 LEFT JOIN `base_patient` `bp` ON `bp`.`patient_id` = `bf`.`patient_id` LEFT JOIN `base_organization` `bo` ON `bo`.`org_id` = `bf`.`org_id` WHERE `bf`.`card_id` = #{cardId} AND `bf`.`choice_benefit_type` = 0 GROUP BY `bf`.`order_id`, `bf`.`order_detail_id` ORDER BY `bf`.`use_date` ASC

select `bci`.`item_id`, `bti`.`item_name`, `bci`.`quantity` as `originalQuantity`, if((`bci`.`quantity` - ifnull(`temp`.`useCount`, 0)) < 0 ,0,`bci`.`quantity` - ifnull(`temp`.`useCount`, 0)) as `remainingQuantity` from `base_card` `c` inner join `base_coupon_item` `bci` on `bci`.`coupon_id` = `c`.`coupon_id` left join `base_tariff_info` `bti` on `bti`.`item_id` = `bci`.`item_id` and `bti`.`item_type` = `bci`.`type` left join (select `bb`.`item_id`, `bb`.`item_type`, `bb`.`card_id`, count(*) as `useCount` from `base_benefit` `bb` where `bb`.`card_id` = #{cardId} and `bb`.`choice_benefit_type` = 0 and `bb`.`coupon_type` in (2, 3) group by `bb`.`item_id`, `bb`.`item_type`) `temp` on `bci`.`item_id` = `temp`.`item_id` and `temp`.`item_type` = `bci`.`type` where `c`.`card_id` = #{cardId} group by `bci`.`item_id`, `bci`.`type`
